cases.name: Roxana Elizabeth Rodriguez
cases.about: In a statement to CBS LA, (her surviving daughter) Desiree Alvarez remembered her mother and sister and thanked the community for their outpouring of support for her and her surviving younger sister. "Hello. My name is Desiree Alvarez. I am the oldest of my mom's 3 daughters," the statement said. "My mom Roxana, was a devoted mother, grandmother, sister, aunt and friend. To know her was to love her. She was the most incredible woman I know. I'm at a loss for words on how much she meant to me. She was my entire world, her and my sisters."
